english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a change or alteration, rather than for a separate version or alternative method.
This is the all-purpose noun for a process or result of becoming different.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for a change or shift in a situation, such as the political atmosphere.
Use this when variety means changing experiences or features that keep something interesting.
